risk.title: Before you trade
risk.p1: Crypto asset prices can move sharply in minutes. You can lose some or all of the money you put in.
risk.p2: Memecoins often have little liquidity and no underlying value. Their prices can fall to zero.
risk.p3: Perpetual futures use leverage. A small price move against you can close your position and you lose the margin you posted. Liquidation prices shown in the app are estimates.
risk.p4: Stock tokens give you price exposure to a company. They are not the same as owning shares directly and may not include voting rights or dividends. Availability varies by region.
risk.p5: Copy trading does not guarantee similar results. Other traders' past performance does not predict future returns.
risk.p6: Content from other users is their opinion. hopium.family does not provide investment advice.
risk.scrollHint: Scroll to the end to continue.

settings.deleteBody: This permanently deletes your profile, posts, theses, follows and settings. Trade records may be kept in anonymized form where the law requires it. This can't be undone.

settings.licensesBody: hopium.family is built with open-source software including React Native, Expo, TanStack Query, Zustand, decimal.js, zod, i18next and lucide icons. Each is used under its own license (MIT, Apache-2.0 or ISC).

faq.a1: In demo mode, no. Every balance, price and trade is simulated so you can explore safely.
faq.q2: Why do I only see size ranges?
faq.a2: To protect privacy, the feed shows trade sizes as ranges unless a trader chooses to share exact amounts.
faq.a3: Each thesis is tracked against live prices. It resolves as hit, invalidated or expired, and your accuracy is hits divided by resolved theses.
